config.implication: the 16x drop table (dq.domain_loss.drops_16x) cannot by itself justify upweighting math/code; decision-relevant quantity is marginal w_d * dL_d/dC_d, not Delta_d

facts.value: filter rules split into corpus-independent (byte/encoding/duplication -- always valid) and corpus-dependent (regex tables, SPAM keyword list, quality-head threshold -- necessarily fail on a new corpus)
facts.source: read of filters/pass1_garbage.py, filters/pass2_garbage.py, filters/pass3_garbage.py, datagen/quality_clf.py SPAM, datagen/train_quality_head.py

config.dependent: pass1-3 regex patterns (written against cosmopedia/fineweb2 failure modes), SPAM gambling/adult keywords, quality-head threshold (trained on web labels)
config.evidence: dependent rules retained 97.1% of CCI3-HQ while hand-read found 40% garbage (dq.cci3.filter_retention, dq.cci3.handread_150)

facts.value: transfer criterion: hand-label N=150 docs from the new corpus, run the corpus-dependent filter on the same docs, compute recall_new = P(filter=drop | hand=garbage); compare to recall_home on the corpus the filter was tuned on; ratio >= 0.8 VALID, < 0.5 RECALIBRATE, in between WEAK (RECALIBRATE if garbage rate > 10%)

config.sample_size: N=150 gives +-0.08 on a proportion at p=0.5; 385 for +-0.05
config.recalibration: cluster hand-labeled garbage by failure pattern, add 1-2 regexes per pattern or a few hundred labels to the quality head, re-test on a FRESH sample until ratio >= 0.8 (never re-test on the calibration sample)
config.thresholds_justification: 0.5 ratio = filter catches less than half of what it catches at home; 0.8 = within normal corpus variation
config.independence: hand-labels for the known-answer case (CCI3-HQ) were produced by aupai-3b for a quality audit before this criterion existed -- not shared assumptions with the criterion

facts.source: arithmetic on dq.cci3.filter_retention (0.971 kept -> 0.029 dropped) and dq.cci3.handread_150 (0.40 garbage): recall = 0.029/0.40 = 0.0725, upper bound assuming every dropped doc was truly garbage

config.known_answer: CCI3-HQ is the negative control: filter is KNOWN to fail there (hand-read 40% garbage, retention 97.1%); criterion outputs RECALIBRATE -- matches the known answer
config.note: verdict does not depend on recall_home: even a perfect home filter gives ratio 0.073 < 0.5
config.positive_control_pending: web_hq with data/web_labels.jsonl on pod -- in-sample by construction (filter tuned on those labels), sanity check only, not a transfer test
